title: Tere Baghair Asghar Nahi Ma Nu Chain Aanda
body:
Lagda Ay Jeevay Menu Asghar Peya Bulanda
<<DIVIDER>>
Raa Vekh Di Sakina Puchdi Rayi Baar Baar Ay
Kyun Dair Layi Asghar Payi Kar Di Intezaar Aye
Hogayi Aye Shaam Aaja Dil Maa Da Dubda Jaanda
<<DIVIDER>>
Chay Maa Da Baal Socho Kitna Hai Pani Peenda
Jay Devna Nayi Paani Ho Teer Na Chalainda
Hurmal Shaki Nu Asghar Reha Pyasay Lab Vakhaunda
<<DIVIDER>>
Kadi Gaud Vekhdiaan Kadi Jhoola Tera Khali
Bhuldi Nahi Maa Dhuki Nu Teri Shakl Bholi Bhali
Ak Band Karan Tay Chehra Tera Nazar Hai Aunda
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Baad Hoya Asghar Baba Tera Shaheed Ay
Hoya Hukam Lut Kay Khaimay Saray Manao Eeid Ay
Jhoolay Tere Nu Asghar Reya Shimr Khud Jalaunda
